entries.title: Psalms 40:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> I waited patiently for the LORD; And He inclined to me, And heard my cry.

entries.title: Psalms 40:2
segments: He also brought me up out of a horrible pit, Out of the miry clay, And set my feet upon a rock, [And] established my steps.

entries.title: Psalms 40:3
segments: He has put a new song in my mouth-Praise to our God; Many will see [it] and fear, And will trust in the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 40:4
segments: Blessed [is] that man who makes the LORD his trust, And does not respect the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

entries.title: Psalms 40:5
segments: Many, O LORD my God, [are] Your wonderful works [Which] You have done; And Your thoughts toward us Cannot be recounted to You in order; [If] I would declare and speak [of them], They are more than can be numbered.

entries.title: Psalms 40:6
segments: ¶Sacrifice and offering You did not desire; My ears You have opened. Burnt offering and sin offering You did not require.

entries.title: Psalms 40:7
segments: Then I said, "Behold, I come; In the scroll of the book [it is] written of me.

entries.title: Psalms 40:8
segments: I delight to do Your will, O my God, And Your law [is] within my heart."

entries.title: Psalms 40:9
segments: I have proclaimed the good news of righteousness In the great assembly; Indeed, I do not restrain my lips, O LORD, You Yourself know.

entries.title: Psalms 40:10
segments: I have not hidden Your righteousness within my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and Your salvation; I have not concealed Your lovingkindness and Your truth From the great assembly.

entries.title: Psalms 40:11
segments: ¶Do not withhold Your tender mercies from me, O LORD; Let Your lovingkindness and Your truth continually preserve me.

entries.title: Psalms 40:12
segments: For innumerable evils have surrounded me; My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; They are more than the hairs of my head; Therefore my heart fails me.

entries.title: Psalms 40:13
segments: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; O LORD, make haste to help me!

entries.title: Psalms 40:14
segments: Let them be ashamed and brought to mutual confusion Who seek to destroy my life; Let them be driven backward and brought to dishonor Who wish me evil.

entries.title: Psalms 40:15
segments: Let them be confounded because of their shame, Who say to me, "Aha, aha!"

entries.title: Psalms 40:16
segments: Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; Let such as love Your salvation say continually, "The LORD be magnified!"

entries.title: Psalms 40:17
segments: But I [am] poor and needy; [Yet] the Lord thinks upon me. You [are] my help and my deliverer; Do not delay, O my God.
